{{Quote|Some pretty serious burns, but nothing a night in the bacta tank won't fix.|Ahsoka Tano to an injured Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>}}
The '''bacta tank''', also known as a '''rejuvenation tank'''<ref name="SW:TRPG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> or a '''rejuve tank''',<ref name="SWTRPG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> was a large, specialized tank that was filled with the powerful healing agent created by the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]], [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], which promoted rapid healing.

==Description==
Bacta tanks were large, specialized medical devices that were filled with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], a liquid that promoted and assisted rapid healing. Patients were immersed in the tank's bacta, wearing a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] to allow them to breathe while the healing agent did its work.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Bacta tanks were expensive and were generally only found in medical centers such as [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]], [[Medical bay/Legends|medical bays]] on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], and in large military bases. Bacta tanks cost around one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase, and weighed around five hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. A [[Liter/Legends|liter]] of bacta weighed around two kilograms and could be bought for one hundred credits.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

==Usage==
A patient was required to be fully submerged within the bacta for the healing agent to do its job. Patients wore breath masks to breathe while submerged. Patients while in the bacta tank wore either white briefs for males or a white sleeveless top and briefs for females. Certain [[Species/Legends|species]], such as [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], experienced complications with the bacta due to their metabolism, sometimes requiring extended submersion.<ref name="XWingRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>

In ideal conditions, Bacta tank worked best the soonest the patient was placed inside. The more the treatment was delayed, the less effective it was. Patients who were unable to enter treatment were risking permanent injuries.

Typically medals and notes would be hung on a tank's [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] surface. Tanks also had a cupboard of the patient's personal belongings.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

==History==
A bacta tank and a supply of bacta were expensive, the tank alone typically costing 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], and so such medical equipment was usually found only in hospitals, on board [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], and within major military bases. Movement of bacta tanks could prove difficult because the tanks weighed roughly 500 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].

Although bacta was near impossible to acquire during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] obtained a functional bacta tank and a small supply of the liquid for use at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. After being attacked by a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] and spending the night on the frozen wastelands of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would have almost surely died from his injuries if not for Echo Base's bacta tank. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] initiated a [[Bacta War]] to liberate the remaining bacta and spread it across the galaxy.
